# Ntfy

Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via PUT/POST

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ntfy/.

## Actions

- **Fetch Cached Messages** (read-only): Fetch cached messages from a ntfy topic.
- **Fetch Latest Message from Topic** (read-only): Fetch the most recent message from a topic's cache.
- **Get Account Information** (read-only): Retrieve account data for authenticated user or anonymous user.
- **Poll Messages from Topic** (read-only): Poll for messages from an ntfy topic without maintaining a long-standing connection.
- **Publish Message as JSON to NTFY**: Publish messages as JSON to ntfy.
- **Publish Message to Topic**: Publish a message to a ntfy topic.
- **Subscribe to Topic (JSON Stream)** (read-only): Subscribe to a ntfy topic and receive messages as JSON stream.
- **Check NTFY Service Health** (read-only): Check the health status of the ntfy service.
- **Create NTFY Account**: Register a new user account on ntfy.
- **Create Web Push Subscription**: Register a web push subscription for browser notifications.
- **Delete Web Push Subscription**: Unregister a web push subscription from the ntfy server.
- **Fetch Scheduled Messages** (read-only): Fetch messages scheduled for later delivery from a topic.
- **Get File Attachment Metadata** (read-only): Get file attachment metadata from a message without downloading the file content.
- **Get Server Statistics** (read-only): Retrieve server statistics including message counts and publishing rates.
- **Get Service Tiers** (read-only): List all available ntfy service tiers with their limits and features.
- **Publish Message to Topic (PUT)**: Publish a message to a topic using PUT method.
- **Publish Message via GET**: Publish messages to ntfy via GET request with URL parameters.
- **Send Message via Webhook**: Send messages via webhook endpoint using simple GET request.
- **Subscribe to Multiple NTFY Topics** (read-only): Subscribe to multiple ntfy topics simultaneously using comma-separated topic list.
- **Subscribe to NTFY Topic with Filters** (read-only): Subscribe to a ntfy topic with filters based on message fields (id, message, title, priority, tags).
- **Subscribe to Topic (Raw Stream)** (read-only): Subscribe to a topic and receive message bodies as raw text stream.
- **Trigger NTFY Webhook**: Trigger a webhook to publish a message to an ntfy topic via simple HTTP GET request.
